confirmed_assessments.assessment: The mapper rejects unsupported signature flags/non-univ parents/signature-local facts; private/mutable/defined/meta fields; declaration disjoint/private/mutable flags; private/recursive functions; temporal/incremental command context and unknown expression/operator families. It emits an empty UNSUPPORTED_CANONICAL value rather than a raw-source fallback.

Global slots follow parser declaration order. Local identities use IdentityHashMap, domains/let values precede binding, lexical maps restore in finally blocks, and the bound ordinal counter is not reset across sibling scopes. Calls refer to registered Func identity. Independent shadow/let/dependent-domain/function-return alpha probes retained identical available payloads/features.

No rendered source, display label, path, comment, name hash or source digest is used in anonymous constructors or feature inputs. Structural strings are fixed tags or checked enum names. AnonymizedArtifact is immutable and package-constructed; EmbeddingEncoder accepts that value rather than an arbitrary source string. This is pseudonymization, not protection against structural re-identification.

Tagged positional arrays retain node kind, namespace/index, operand order, null optional return versus arrays, fact order and selected bounds. Exact compact JSON UTF-8 is hashed. Feature encoding follows fixed four-byte chunks, SHA-256 first-two-byte bucket mod128, and L2 normalization. Feature collisions are expected and have no equality authority.

The11 committed tests cover non-vacuous signature/field/function/parameter alpha controls, shadowing, declaration order versus spelling, distinct signatures, multiplicity/operand order, unsupported signature/inheritance/disjoint cases, fact/scope changes, JSON round-trip/vector norm and string/temporal rejection. These remain finite observations.
